limitations: Each live condition one diagnostic case; no rates or statistical significance.
State arm bundles memory, question, vocabulary and sampling.
Reference step1 already shows notification text; e5 badge/eligibility becomes available after gaze.
UI response batch API4 deliberately censors combined; not task-performance comparison.
Model is not seed-controllable; sampler seed alone does not reproduce model distribution.
API latency is not human task time.
No human equivalence or public-product generalization tested.

repeatReferenceEvidence.interpretation: First three recorded model inputs and sampler draws match, but returned distributions differ; actual third selection diverges. This within-reference variation prevents attributing the single position-only trace difference to UI.
